requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve an auditable transition from the released artifact to the new revision
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Drive-Artifact Gate and Drive Artifact Contract require released or frozen deliverables to use an auditable version transition or supersession instead of silent replacement.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep the prior asset relation visible through versioning or supersession
requiredBehaviors.evidence: ASSETS.md and the artifact contract retain historical relationships and superseded assets so the prior released state remains traceable.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: update ASSETS state and the release event only with observed Drive metadata
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Drive write contract requires post-write read-back verification and permits only observed Drive IDs, URLs, MIME types, parent and modification state to be recorded.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: silently overwrite a released or frozen artifact without an auditable version transition
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly prohibits silent overwrites of released or frozen external artifacts.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: delete the superseded asset from project memory history
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The ASSETS and history contracts require superseded relationships to remain visible rather than deleting old evidence.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: create a new project Drive folder for the revision
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Exactly one canonical Drive project folder is allowed and downstream revisions must reuse the documented folder ID.
